items.title: The Web Can't Afford a JavaScript Runtime Monoculture
items.blurb: Earlier this month Deno announced its whole team is joining Cloudflare. In the announcement, Ryan Dahl, who created Node.js and started Deno in 2018, also explains that development of the Deno runtime will stop after one year.
